The fixed-parameter first-derivative hypersurface is irreducible by a nondegenerate rank-at-least-three quadric pencil; the second derivative does not vanish identically, producing codimension two for multiple critical points. A separate codimension-two incidence excludes critical points at the GD cut locus, as witnessed by the coprime cut-determinant and derivative polynomials. The incidence dimension bound ensures generic simple critical points, and local infinity expansion excludes ramification there. Riemann-Hurwitz gives 2 delta - 2, and the nonempty Zariski-open conditions inside the irreducible full projection data variety transfer the count. Exact sample polynomial checker gives independent finite sanity checks without replacing the proof.
